title: A Study in Scarlet
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Dr Watson, back from war and looking for lodgings, meets an odd chemist called Sherlock Holmes. Together they investigate a dead man in an empty house and a word scrawled in blood on the wall.
readIf: you want to meet Holmes and Watson at the start and enjoy a Victorian puzzle with a surprising second half.
skipIf: you want a single steady plot, as the second half jumps to a different time and place.

pairings.reason: The most popular Holmes novel, with a more atmospheric and tightly focused case.
A modern London detective story with a brooding investigator and his younger assistant.
